title: Escape-hatch Playbook: Privileged Recovery, Emergency Key Rotation, and IdP Failover
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Create a compact, operator-friendly escape-hatch playbook for emergencies affecting RBAC v2, SSO (SAML/IdP), KMS keys, and audit log access. This ticket delivers: a step-by-step runbook for urgent privileged-account recovery; scripts and one-liners for emergency key rotation and session revocation; IdP failover checklist (federation/standalone); sample support macros for tier-1/2 to expedite escalation; and tested extraction commands for audit logs with redaction guidance. The playbook must be consumable by on-call engineers with minimal context and must include rollback paths and post-mortem checkpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook covers four emergency categories: compromised admin credentials, IdP outage, KMS key compromise, and audit log inaccessible
All commands and scripts are published in the internal secure repo with readme links
Support macros are vetted by Support and Security and added to the macros library
Playbook includes a tested IdP failover procedure and automated session revocation steps
Security review sign-off recorded and smoke tests for key rotation validated in staging
steps: Triage: confirm scope (affected customers, regions, services). Record incident id in incident tracker.
Containment: disable affected admin SSO groups by toggling the 'admin-access' claim in the IdP or temporarily set login policy to 'password-only' for a timeboxed window.
Emergency session revocation: run 'authctl revoke-sessions --role admin --since=2025-03-02T00:00:00Z' from control-plane (example one-liner provided).

KMS key emergency rotation: 1) identify key ARN, 2) create new key in KMS, 3) rewrap secrets via 'secretsctl rewrap --from-key old --to-key new', 4) rotate service principal certificates; keep old key disabled (not deleted) for 30 days before scheduled deletion.

IdP failover: switch routing to backup IdP by updating federation-binding in config-store -> propagate, then verify SSO login with a test admin account. If federation is broken, enable fallback local admin account per scoped SOP.
Audit log extraction: use 'audit-export --start=... --end=... --filter=\"role:admin OR action:privilege_change\" --redact=PII' and store encrypted bundle in secure-drive for review.
Rollback and recovery: document the precise change that contained the incident and reverse via tracked PR with feature-flag; keep a timeline of every action taken.
Post-incident: schedule blameless post-mortem, generate list of remediation tickets (policy updates, improved metrics/alerts), and update this playbook artifact with lessons learned.
Communication: use the incident Slack channel and template macros to notify customers with minimal technical noise; escalate to legal/compliance for any PII exposure.
Testing: run the 'escape-hatch smoke' in staging quarterly and record results in the playbook appendix.
support_macros: Macro: ESC-HATCH-PRI - Short: 'We've initiated emergency privileged access containment. We're revoking admin sessions and rotating keys where necessary. You'll be informed within 60 minutes. If you are affected, reply with org-id and time-window.'
Macro: ESC-HATCH-AUD - Short: 'Audit export in progress. Request queued. Expect redacted audit bundle available to compliance within 4 hours.'
Macro: ESC-HATCH-IDP - Short: 'Temporary authentication change applied to protect accounts. Please reauthenticate; if you cannot, open a support ticket with 'idp-failover' in the subject.'
scripts_snippets: One-liner revoke (control-plane): curl -XPOST https://control-plane/api/v1/auth/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN' -d '{"filter":"role=admin AND last_active>2025-03-01"}'
KMS rotate sample: aws kms create-key --description 'emergency-rotate' && secretsctl rewrap --from-key arn:old --to-key arn:new --batch-size 200
notes: Design decision: prefer disabling vs deleting keys to preserve ability to decrypt historical logs for forensic analysis.
Tradeoff: rapid KMS rotation increases short-term operational load; mitigate with automation and staged rotation.
Operational constraint: any playbook action that may impact >5% of customers requires Exec notification prior to change.
